def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    starting_index_value = 121
    starting_prices = [15, 20, 30]
    ending_prices = [20, 30, 25]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    percentage_changes = [
        ending / starting - 1
        for starting, ending in zip(starting_prices, ending_prices)
    ]
    equal_weighted_change = sum(percentage_changes) / len(percentage_changes)
    answer = round(starting_index_value * (1 + equal_weighted_change), 3)

    # return answer
    return answer
